scope: Consumer CLI sequence, bundled examples and bundled regression test on three operating systems, using these exact tarball bytes installed offline with --ignore-scripts in a fresh directory. No physical, real-credential, GitHub write or production run.
checks: SHA-256 of the installed tarball equals artifactSha256
LIMITED_BLOCKING: allowed ADMITTED/AUTHORIZED/SUCCEEDED exit 0; replay UNRESOLVED/DECISION_REUSED exit 4; denied DENIED/OUT_OF_SCOPE exit 3; unresolved UNRESOLVED/EVIDENCE_MISSING exit 4
status UNRESOLVED after the sequence; verify exit 0 with count 5
SHADOW: allowed and denied exit 0 with execution.outcome OBSERVED
examples/first-operation.mjs and examples/tamper-after-approval.mjs output matched (tamper: UNRESOLVED/TARGET_CHANGED, 0 simulated executions)
with GUARD_DEBUG=1 set, no 'guard debug:' line on the normal sequence
control: On Windows 11, 0.1.0-preview.3 returned UNRESOLVED/GUARD_UNAVAILABLE for every guard protect (directory fsync EPERM in the file evidence store). That failure is the reason for this release.
